thesis: Josh Wolfe argues that the ability to tackle massive scale problems has never been greater due to cheap capital and cheap narrative distribution, which allows visionary leaders like Elon Musk to galvanize human and financial capital through compelling stories. He outlines a five-item checklist for CEOs derived from Zander Lurie, emphasizing the necessity of defining strategy, securing capital through storytelling, building an execution team, communicating consistently, and holding people accountable.
